name: 話の要点・コーラル帯デザイン

canvas.note: Working portrait target. Keep the supplied footage timing/frame-rate behavior when selecting actual project settings; reference geometry is normalized, not native1080pixels.

required: current footage with original spoken audio
optional: current clinic LP or official information for clinic name, access, branding and valid offer
explicit user-provided clinic and posting destination information
input.missingInputAction: Request current original-speech footage only. Do not delay speech analysis merely because LP is absent; omit or clarify unverified clinic/offer/CTA facts.

flow: Read the active host basics, speech-editing and transcription skills; inspect current footage and listen to relevant speech. Make timestamped ASR for internal analysis only.
Distinguish speakers, actual patient experience, provider explanation, questions, negation, time and conditions. Verify candidate overlay facts against original audio; record source timestamps.
Select a short context line, large theme and one concise supporting message. Display this hierarchy as persistent summary graphics, not every spoken word.
Use current official LP or user-confirmed information only for clinic name, access, offer, color requests and booking destination. Do not use reference clinic facts by default.
Edit through normally with supported copy; pause for copy review only when explicitly requested or when a consequential fact remains ambiguous. Do not create a universal script-approval gate.

Preserve original speech and meaningful examination/treatment continuity; apply patient face mosaic using face-mosaic.md; create independently editable graphic layers using current host-supported tools.
Review semantic fidelity, composite layout, audio, cuts, timing and all face-exposure frames. Report actual verified scope; local export only when requested.

speechAnalysis.summarySource: current original speech, checked against audio
doNotInfer: diagnosis from image or topic alone
a patient statement not actually said
speechAnalysis.literalQuoteRule: Use quotation marks only for faithful quoted speech. A paraphrase/summary must not masquerade as an exact patient quote.
speechAnalysis.ambiguousAction: Proceed with verified independent elements; omit optional uncertain claims, or ask for the specific fact if needed for the main message.

editing.default: Original live treatment footage with persistent topic graphics; preserve original voice and demonstration continuity.
editing.duration: Follow current speech and action; never force40.54seconds, source overlay transition or source shot count.
editing.frame: Keep therapist, hands and relevant treatment body region readable above/beside the graphics; adjust text length and layout to current framing.

brandingAndCta.accentStatus: Approximate encoded reference coral; original design token unknown.
brandingAndCta.lpColorPolicy: When user requests LP branding, use verified LP colors for accent while keeping hierarchy and readable white/black pairing. Otherwise preserve reference coral design.
brandingAndCta.clinicAccessSource: Current LP/official information or explicit user-provided confirmed facts only.
brandingAndCta.unverifiedClinicInfo: Omit or request only the needed facts; never copy the reference clinic/access.
brandingAndCta.unverifiedOffer: Omit campaign/limited-period claims. The source offer is not a new default.
brandingAndCta.cta: Use actual confirmed posting destination and valid instruction; arrows must correspond to that surface. Omit if unknown.

graphicStyle.text: bold/heavy Japanese Gothic; exact font unconfirmed

productionApprovedProfile.status: One new-footage ChatCut composite approved by the user on 2026-10-23. This is a reusable typography/layout profile, not reusable clinic copy or a claim of exact source-font identity.

font.role: default supported A06 approximation when available
font.evidence: Compared in the ChatCut renderer using the same Japanese copy against M PLUS 1p, Zen Kaku Gothic New and Dela Gothic One; user approved the Noto Sans JP revision.
font.identity: approximation; original reference font remains unidentified
font.fallback: Search the active renderer catalog and compare the actual current Japanese wording in the composed frame. Do not use file availability or glyph coverage alone as approval.

tracking.note: If copy does not fit, adjust size, card width or deliberate line breaks before tightening character spacing.

twoLineText.note: Judge line gap and character spacing separately at a large one-up composed frame; avoid a compressed block.

smallCopy.policy: When side margins are visibly wasteful, enlarge the copy before shrinking the card. Preserve safe edge padding and re-check longer clinic/access wording.

hierarchy.primaryTopic: Largest element. Scale by actual character count; short 3-4 character topics may exceed the flattened reference's approximate 56px equivalent.
hierarchy.contextAndSupport: Larger than the first draft when the frame has unused width; still subordinate to the topic band.
hierarchy.clinicCard: Clinic name strongest; access second; use an explicit vertical gap rather than compressed line-height.

approvedGeometry1080x1920.adaptationRule: These are approved composition proportions from one 1080x1920 example. Scale to the canvas and current footage, fit actual text, and keep treatment/hands visible; do not hard-code them when the framing or copy differs.

reviewOrder: render one large settled body frame
render one large settled closing frame

Compare the actual current Japanese wording against the provided reference images, then adjust size, tracking, line-height and card padding in that order. Use another supported heavy Japanese Gothic only after a specimen/composite comparison.

facePrivacy.referenceObservedEffect: Existing heavy blur on patient face; not a newly added pixel mosaic.
facePrivacy.verification: All exposure frames in current finished composite per common rule, including movement, reflections, cut boundaries and first/last frames.

audio.referencePreview: H264/AAC packet-preserving remux; no added sound.

editingAndCorrection.textOnlyCorrection: Update only affected graphic text, glyphs/layout if needed; preserve edited video, original audio, timing and face mosaic.
editingAndCorrection.glyphBasedRenderer: If using generated glyph paths, text changes require glyph/layout regeneration; do not promise typing alone updates all renderers.
editingAndCorrection.timingChange: After any actual speech cut, retime graphics/closing and verify picture/audio and last frame.

reference.speechAnalysisStatus: Timestamped ASR candidates from two models suggest conversation about golf, scores and rounds; not a fully auditioned transcript. Visible medication/diagnosis/pain-free outcome copy is not established by the audio analysis alone.
reference.cutObservation: Single apparent treatment scene in sampled timeline and numeric upper-image scan; no clearly separate scene cut found, not proof that source was uncut.

helperCompatibility.reason: Requires semantic summary from current original speech and current clinic facts, editable persistent graphics and per-shot patient privacy; not a fixed cue/timeline helper route.

verification.newSemanticCopyVerificationScope: User explicitly confirmed the main topic and approved the final edit. Supporting copy was ASR-grounded, but this audit did not independently audition the original audio.
verification.report: One new-footage editable ChatCut composite and the revised Noto Sans JP typography/spacing were approved. Separate this from independent original-audio audition, whole-frame privacy certification, full audio playback, export and other-operator tests.
